facts.value: Examination results earned at a university are generally only credited if they were completed no more than five calendar years before the start of the Master's program.
An application for credit transfer must be submitted with the application. A proof of all previously earned credits at a university must be attached (detailed performance record).
Credits from a Bachelor's program cannot be transferred to the Master's program.
The ranking of applicants is based on a value consisting of 60% from the grade of the required degree or preliminary average grade and 40% from the grade of the study exposé.

For the evaluation of the study exposé, in addition to the external quality and presentation, the study motivation and intended career perspective, as well as the previously acquired and proven knowledge in Economic Education and quantitative methods are significant.
Please complete the online application in full. You have the opportunity to upload required documents already in the online portal.
Applications are processed through an online system provided and operated by uni-assist e.V.
You can digitally submit and assign all required documents, such as CV and certificates, via the upload function.
Certified copies of required documents must only be submitted for enrollment in the new study program.
Applicants with foreign certificates must prove at least German language skills at the level of the Central Intermediate Examination (C1 Intermediate) when applying.
Every provisionally admitted applicant must take and pass the DSH-2 exam before the start of lectures. Failure to provide proof in a timely manner will invalidate the provisional admission.
If you do not yet have proof of eligibility for the consecutive Master's program (Bachelor certificate), please apply with the following additional documents by July 15.
Proof of enrollment in the Bachelor's program and a preliminary certificate indicating an average grade and all previous examination results.
Since the winter semester 2008/09, no tuition fees are required. This also applies to long-term study and second-degree fees.
The semester fee for the Master's program is approximately €350 per semester.
A final admission occurs after submission of the Bachelor's certificate within a specified exclusion period.

A provisional admission can be granted under the condition of obtaining additional credits from the Bachelor's program in the amount of max. 60 CP if you are applying with an economics Bachelor's degree.
